svg.aria-label: Secrets Manager and Parameter Store property key mapping flow
svg.text: Remote values become ordinary Spring property keys before @ConfigurationProperties reads them.

g.text: JSON object values are recursively flattened and joined with the configured prefix
Parameter names lose the configured root path, then remaining path segments become dotted keys
Spring sees the same property key no matter which AWS source supplied the value

svg.text: Secrets and parameters converge into normal Spring keys before application configuration binds.
